title: fight dust
description: Purely visual mod adding dust, enchant hit, and campfire signal smoke particles between attacking mobs and targets. No config, no maintenance, Forge 1.20.1 only.
body:
Fight Dust is a purely visual mod that adds immersive particle effects when mobs attack their targets.
When a monster fights another mob or player, it will spawn dust, enchant hit, and campfire signal smoke particles between the attacker and its target.

Key Notes

Only visual effects — no changes to game mechanics, balance, items, or blocks

No configuration files (particle behavior is fixed and cannot be customized)

No active maintenance (the mod is functional for Forge 1.20.1 and will not receive updates)

Lightweight, performance-friendly, compatible with all mobs

Requires Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 (47.0.0+)

About creation: This mod's description and particle logic were AI-assisted. The mod itself is fully functional for its intended purpose.
